checks.expected_behavior: Charge one call once or leave ambiguous fields unknown

finding.title: Duplicate physical-log states for one call_id are summed as separate token expenditures
finding.source_reachability: Frozen HFBackend._record appends SUCCESS before file write; OSError from that write enters generate except, which records FAILED with the same call_id. No second generation is executed.
finding.recommended_fix: For each attempted request, preserve all event rows but do not sum repeated states for the same call_id; merge proven nonconflicting metrics or leave ambiguous totals null. Add an explicit synthetic log-write fault test.

recommendation: Repair the identified failure-accounting edge case before a separately budgeted synthetic real-model engineering qualification; no scientific admission.
